notes.title: Major Quality of Life Update for Emperor of the Fading Suns
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks to everyone for your continuing feedback on the Emperor of the Fading Suns Enhanced! [/p][p]This update prioritizes three areas:[/p][olist][*][p]Quality-of-life fixes you have told us will make a big difference for you;[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes (thankful to say that while there are a number of these, none were especially big); and[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for the map editor and modding.[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b][/h1][p]Okay, you were right. These REALLY speed up gameplay – just watch [url="https://youtube.com/live/K_p6NI-Ap6Y?feature=share"]our most recent streams![/url][/p][h3][b]New Message Window[/b][/h3][p]This was easily one of the most-requested QoL changes. At the start of your turn you will see a new Messages dialog, with all the messages on one screen, You can exit out of these and never have to respond to most of them. [/p][p]This means that you no longer receive a lot of building prompts at the start of a turn. Instead, you get a list and can resolve each city at your convenience, either through this new message screen or by visiting the city itself. Cities default to “No Production” if you do not give them anything new to produce.[/p][p]Note that while you still need to respond to diplomatic entreaties (especially threats of war), we added a setting to the EFS.ini file so you can turn this feature off for most diplomatic requests.[/p][p]We are aware of a graphic glitch that puts lines under the message (and other text) when you play at 1366 x 768 resolution. We hope you do not find this a problem, but we are looking into it.[/p][h3][b]No More Build Confirmation[/b][/h3][p]This in itself shaves a lot of time off turns, especially later in the game. EFSe no longer asks for confirmation when starting unit production, or when building nothing. The prompt still appears if you change production from one unit to another to ensure you do not inadvertently waste resources.[/p][h3][b]More QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added support for razing roads – the Build Road command now razes instead if a road is already there. Neither costs movement[/p][/*][*][p]Added health penalty tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Transports can now also be loaded by dragging the unit to another unit already in the transport and not requiring you take the unit off the transport first[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some inconsistencies with unloading transports[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “Select All” functionality when the current selection is sentried,[/p][/*][*][p]Added clergy counts to cathedral descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]The AI now correctly follows the 20 unit stack limitation[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p]What bugs? We are just changing unintended functionality to intended  Okay, we admit … they were bugs[/p][h3][b]Ministry Unit Confusion[/b][/h3][p]This update addresses a few cases of the player’s own units intermingling with ministry units under player control (a so-called mixed stack), which caused a number of issues both technical and design-wise:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where units captured using ministry units would be assigned to the player’s House.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where claiming the reward from a cleared ruin using ministry units would create a mixed stack. The reward is assigned to the player’s own House. The ministry unit used to claim it remains outside. An exception to this is when defending spaceships capitulate in the ruin tile. To avoid a mixed stack situation, moving a ministry unit in to claim the reward will also place it under ministry control. Move ministry units out first to keep it for yourself![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buying from an Agora could place House resources among ministry units. Purchased resources will be given to the player’s House if there is room to do so without creating a mixed stack. Purchased resources will be placed under the control of the player’s ministry if only ministry cities and units have room. These resources can be used to produce either house or ministry units, [b]but will be lost if the ministry changes owners![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Naval Transports not understanding House and ministry boundaries when loading and unloading units.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ministry cities overflowing their production into a tile occupied by units from the player’s house.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some problems with assigning ministries[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all ministries having to share the same 20 units limit in space. Now each ministry can now bring a full 20 units without hindering the others.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
Lab/Research Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed research progression loss when assigning an additional lab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lost lab research overflow after selecting ‘Nothing’.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed out of control inactive labs count in the research window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some problems with research point calculations[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]General Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crashes when disbanding units from the Group Finder[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when embarking unit into adjacent transports could crash the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hung game if a minister’s House is eliminated in the same turn the Ministry is assigned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where interrupting a unit’s movement with the spacebar would teleport the next unit moved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed when Space, Jump or Lander move types couldn’t exit a transport on a river tile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Zero-movement units being able to board transports[/p][/*][*][p]New units are no longer built on top of ruins if there’s no free space in the actual city[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problems with splitting some cargo types[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue that was causing some units to be invisible and unselectable[/p][/*][*][p]AI bombardment now always respects movement point count[/p][/*][*][p]Plague no longer infects ruins[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a regression causing empty cities to not build units correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with ship movement in coastal cities[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some ruins that were hidden under cities on the standard map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem with transports being disbandable while loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other very rare crashes[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Modding/Map Editor[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Improved map editor import – added an Update All Planets option[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality to the map editor – randomize and clear planets[/p][/*][*][p]Improved randomization in the map editor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed naval transports that do not have Naval move type (only happens in mods)[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to mod some Byzantium Secundus behavior, especially in how AI builds and uses units[/p][/*][*][p]Map editor CSV import improvements – Fixed special characters in mass save[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some map editor crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Added an efs.ini setting to auto-reject unresolved treaties – [i]prompt_treaties_end_turn[/i]. Even on auto-reject, treaties threatening war must be replied to[/p][/*][/list][p]
You can also see this list at [url="https://holistic-design.com/aug-10-2025-update-for-emperor-of-the-fading-suns-enhanced-on-steam-and-and-gog/"]https://holistic-design.com/aug-10-2025-update-for-emperor-of-the-fading-suns-enhanced-on-steam-and-and-gog/[/url][/p]

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bigger changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Focus no longer automatically switches to a different unit after moving
[*] The planet view now shows the currently built unit in each city (if any), including the remaining turns (Ctrl+P toggles)
[*] Added a Finances dialog with itemized income/expense overviews, accessible from the House screen
[*] Added tooltips to the unit and build dialogs, explaining the effects of unit stats
[/list]

[h2]Smaller changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a fuel gauge to units that require one
[*] The Esc key now works in the unit view, build and message dialogs
[*] The City screen now automatically opens when building a new city
[*] Adjusted the unexplored terrain colors
[*] Galaxy-wide relics now work in space
[*] 'Select All' now correctly accounts for towed units
[*] Rebels no longer activate ruins before turn 50
[*] CTRL+G (grid) and CTRL+T (city names) toggles now work correctly
[*] The AI is better at handling ruins
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem causing the production timer to go negative
[*] Fixed shortcuts with modifiers
[*] Fixed behaviour when trying to enter a city containing a naval transport
[*] Fixed a crash when closing a build or tech dialog with no unit selected
[*] Fixed transports being invulnerable in certain situations
[*] Fixed button clicks sometimes not registering
[*] Fixed retreating ministry-owned units
[*] Fixed a mapeditor crash when hitting Esc in the New dialog
[/list]

[h2]Modding:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added basic modding instructions to the MOD dir
[*] Unit animations can now be static images (PNG, etc)
[*] Ruin activation is moddable
[*] Blank artwork files are moddable
[*] Mapper CSV import no longer crashes
[/list]

notes.title: Emperor of the Fading Suns Next Fest Livestream 7 pm EST June 17
notes.notes:
Tune in 7 pm EST June 17 as we livestream on https://www.youtube.com/GeorgiaGameDevs

This classic 4X strategy game has survived for more than 25 years thanks to the devotion of dedicated fans and modders. Now you too can enjoy Emperor of the Fading Suns, renowned for its deep game play and unparalleled setting. First released in 1997, this is the Enhanced version of the game released on its 25th anniversary with significant upgrades and improvements.

Battle on land, air, sea and space as you fight for control of humanity’s known worlds as one of five Royal Houses.
Utilize combined arms tactics to overcome enemy positions.
Use a robust diplomacy engine to trade technologies, political offices, threats, favors and even votes for the imperial crown.
Enjoy a powerful economic engine that allows you to trade any of the dozens of resources you develop.
Avoid the machinations of the Church and the anger of powerful alien races.
Recruit legions of theurigists, psychics, mutants, warbeasts and more.

Modders have been enjoying this game for years, and this build ships with everything you need to create your own star-spanning maps and campaigns.
